A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (23 December 2022). Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-chewbacca-PC-Errata-D-E1-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Chewbacca (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]] (by 17 August 2019): The game text changes: “starships” becomes “starships,”; “that are 'hit' and about to be lost” is added after “site”; “(rather than Lost Pile) when they are 'hit.'” becomes “instead.”. The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels: sharper art and frame, lore and game text set again; the bronze disc is gone and the mark “D-E1” is printed in the black lower border.

The whole 2019 disc card image and the whole 2022 D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
